gaps.sentence: He decided to go ___ for the chess championship.
gaps.explanation: 'Go in for' = take part in a competition.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
